messages.author: d0b18666fe8582cb
messages.subject: error when using empirical.poly.collapse
parts:
Hi Phil,

I keep getting the error below when I try to use the empirical.poly.collapse function in itemfit. I am able to get it to work on some items, but not others. Any thoughts?

Thanks so much!

> empirical.plot.irt.pa1.6 <- itemfit(irt.pa1, group.bins=20, empirical.plot = 6, empirical.poly.collapse = TRUE)
Error in 1L:ncol(P) : argument of length 0

Keri

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: error when using empirical.poly.collapse
parts:
Ugh, sorry about that. It looks to be a classic dropping dimensions issue with R. I've made a patch on Github that can be installed for the fix.

Phil
